id: title:Gilbert09:name the failure when a temporary api error outlives retries

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion failure handling and customer communication
review.reason: Adds a customer-facing message for Matomo API errors while retaining internal markers, and includes a test asserting that raw HTTP status codes are not exposed to end users. This demonstrates a bounded improvement in warehouse ingestion reliability and customer experience.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation of a customer-facing message and its test, but the actual production impact and complete implementation of the broader warehouse ingestion changes are not fully demonstrated in this specific hunk. No unverified outcomes are inferred.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retry_exhausted_errors returning a customer-facing message for the Matomo API error, while retaining the internal marker as the key.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a clearer, user-facing explanation for warehouse ingestion failures rather than exposing raw HTTP status or internal markers.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that the customer-facing message replaces the raw HTTP status and includes scheduling guidance.
observations.posthog_connection: Validates that warehouse ingestion failure messages do not expose raw status codes to end users, supporting a cleaner customer experience.
